data.action: 手指抵着下巴默读剧本，帽子放在荧光笔与便签旁。
data.description: 事务所会议室，她面前摊着画满荧光笔与便签的剧本，手指抵着下巴默读台词；围读还没有开始，她已经完全沉浸在角色里——努力家的素颜。
data.promptProse: Before the table read begins, Kana studies an annotated script in the agency meeting room, one fingertip against her chin as she silently rehearses. Her cream cardigan, white blouse and navy skirt remain in the medium environmental view. Fluorescent highlights and sticky notes cover the near pages, with empty chairs behind. Soft overhead studio light brightens her thoughtful face and paper, leaving gentle shadows around the page tabs.
data.title: 有马加奈 · 剧本围读的荧光笔
